policy: Keep message_type=notification (and other overloaded carriers) plus metadata.card_type. Do not add DB message_types for visual variants unless storage/aggregation semantics differ. A card type is never removed from `attachments` outright — retire it in `attachment_lifecycle` first (see docs/Card Catalog.md §8.1); historical messages keep rendering their durable text fallback via RetiredCardFallback.

atlas_draft.notes: Deprecated compatibility projection. No new production writer; retained so historical owner-scoped messages can render during the retention window.

document_edit.notes: FE mapper + Catalog support; promote a BE writer only with a real producer

itinerary_operation.notes: FE mapper + Catalog support; promote a BE writer only with a real producer

composed_card.notes: Validated CardBlueprint v1 composed from server-authored, audience-safe artifacts; the model never supplies executable UI or actions.

no_arrival.change_applied: Side-effect of propose_change auto-apply / vote resolution — not its own streamed tool; propose_change already reserves vote_widget
no_arrival.error_recovery: Posted by planning_workflow async recovery, outside the chat tool loop
no_arrival.notification_card: Proactive / automation systems; appears after history deliver, not mid-tool
no_arrival.taste_dna_reflection: Post-turn reflection hook, not a card-producing agent tool
no_arrival.document_edit: Planning/doc metadata variant without a dedicated mid-turn producer tool
no_arrival.narration: Narrate endpoint persists a narration row; not the concierge tool stream
no_arrival.lazy_research: Research worker posts text + metadata.kind after background work
no_arrival.itinerary_operation: Itinerary op prep via notification metadata; not a card-arrival tool
no_arrival.composed_card: Presentation is selected after grounded artifacts are available; it is intentionally not tied to one streamed tool.
no_arrival.atlas_draft: Deprecated compatibility-only attachment. New Atlas draft arrivals are not permitted; historical messages retain their owner-scoped renderer until retirement.
